unavailable_or_unclassified: Qualified root-working finite optical-port model, not measured device performance, an acquired interface from the old signed spin handles, or practical advantage. Positive real exchange and a common quiet/dark/idle memory Hamiltonian, a supplied optical controller and single-photon source, real computational preparation, fresh outgoing drains, detection and holding are substantive requirements. Singular-value information alone, a sampled bath calibration, an auxiliary gap or a retained coherent drain is insufficient. Failed parity operations may flip live data and cannot be retried harmlessly. Scalar average loss/detection is not a uniform memory-independent qualification. The source retains stronger ordinary quantum-interrogation, cavity-scattering and filtered/offline optical comparators. No independent scientific audit of this new package is supplied.
